baseline_models.mechanism: The offspring are fixed as inhabitants at one protected node while the valley, moving hearts, and apportioned provision form inbound channels. Local immobility and external circulation are complementary rather than contradictory.

activation_trace.role: Habitation and taking a dwelling supply the fixed human node around which the mechanism turns.
A valley as a floodcourse supplies a receptive channel rather than merely an empty depression.
Rapid coursing movement supplies the inbound human motion toward the settled family.
Apportioned giving supplies the material flow that sustains the fixed node.

changed_reading.before: Abraham leaves part of his family in an isolated barren place and asks that they survive.
changed_reading.after: Abraham establishes a stationary sanctuary node designed to be sustained by directed flows of people and apportioned goods.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ ... لِيُقِيمُوا ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ... ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ... يَشْكُرُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Botanical cultivation is explicitly absent, yet prayer is made upright and provision is asked to issue in fruit and gratitude. The sequence sketches a non-botanical cultivation in which ritual stability bears social and ethical yield.

activation_trace.role: Exclusion and negation sharpen the deliberate absence of native cultivation.
Sowing and vegetative growth supply the expressly missing production system.
Uprightness and ordered stability make prayer the activity to be established in place of crop production.
The specified act of worship supplies the settlement's primary cultivated practice.
Fruit as a generated benefit permits material produce to double as the yield of the whole arrangement.
A little input showing a visible good effect makes gratitude the regenerative yield rather than a polite afterword.

changed_reading.before: The lack of crops is a deficit repaired by imported fruit.
changed_reading.after: The lack of crops foregrounds another cultivation: prayer is established, provision bears fruit, and gratitude makes its effect visible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ ... فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِى إِلَيْهِمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Protected space and a settled family become an attractor for inwardly heated human centers. The requested making configures not only affection but a gravity combining desire, descent, and rapid approach.

activation_trace.role: A spatial sanctuary enclosed by prohibition supplies the protected attractor.
Causing something to assume a state supplies the requested reconfiguration of human interiors.
The heart viewed as inward heat supplies an affective center with energy rather than a neutral preference.
Human sociability that removes estrangement supplies the relational field from which attachment is drawn.
Falling into a depth supplies the strong spatial pull implicit in movement toward the family.
Desire and inward inclination supply the voluntary affective face of the same motion.

changed_reading.before: The prayer simply asks strangers to feel affection for the family.
changed_reading.after: The prayer asks for a divinely configured inward gravity by which warm desire becomes actual movement toward a protected human center.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier love fastens on worldly life while obstructing and bending the path; later a call receives a response despite lacking coercive authority. Against both scenes, the focus request directs desire toward a prayer-centered family, making heart-inclination a contested, non-coercive orientation.

activation_trace.role: Love adhering to the heart supplies the rival attachment that can capture human orientation.
A traversable extended road supplies the directional axis from which the rival attachment turns people away.
Deviation from straightness supplies the bent trajectory opposed to the focus's directed approach.
Power and governing authority, explicitly absent in the sequence, mark the later response as attraction without coercion.
Calling that verbally draws another supplies a competing summons directed at human responsiveness.
Answering speech supplies the responsive completion of a non-coercive call.
Voluntary desire supplies the focus's counter-directed heart vector.
Upright establishment of prayer supplies the destination's ordering center.

structural_cues: 14:3 couples preferred worldly attachment with blocking the path and seeking it bent.
14:22 explicitly reduces the rival mechanism to call and response without coercive authority.
14:37 gives the requested heart-motion a destination beside the protected house and a purpose in established prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival attachments, a coercionless call-response, and directed hearts; I infer that these are competing orientation systems. A live alternative is that 14:37 concerns local affection and travel without evoking the earlier ideological contest.

changed_reading.before: People's affection is a benign social aid to an isolated family.
changed_reading.after: People's affection is a redirected capacity of desire: a voluntary answer to a prayer-centered attractor amid rival loves, bent paths, and calls.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sequence of provision, fruit, and hoped-for gratitude becomes recursive under the earlier conditional promise: gratitude opens increase, whereas covering a blessing blocks its recognition. The final purpose can therefore feed the settlement's continued provision.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the return path from gratitude to renewed abundance.
Covering a blessing supplies the negative interruption of the recognition-and-increase loop.
Ripened fruit supplies the visible input whose reception can elicit gratitude.
A small input producing a visible good effect makes gratitude operationally generative.

structural_cues: 14:7 states gratitude and increase in a conditional sequence.
14:37 closes the request for fruit with the purpose clause لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional increase and the focus's fruit-to-gratitude order; I infer a feedback arrow from gratitude into future sustaining provision. The increase may instead be non-material or deferred rather than more fruit.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is the devotional endpoint after food arrives.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is also the settlement's regenerative hinge: received fruit becomes recognized blessing, and recognized blessing opens increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good word is pictured as a tree with fixed root, elevated branch, and recurring yield. That pattern crosses into the focus paradox: although native crop is absent, prayer is made upright and the arrangement is asked to bear fruit, so the settled worshiping lineage can be read as a word-tree rather than an agricultural plantation.

activation_trace.role: The trunked tree supplies the context's explicit organic model.
Deep-rooted firmness supplies stable anchoring for the model.
Durable fixity supplies the tree's persistence and maps onto established prayer.
A high branch issuing from its root supplies outward extension from a fixed base.
The yield of tree and crop supplies recurring produce despite the focus's uncultivated ground.
Sown vegetative growth supplies the physical system explicitly missing from the valley.
Upright stability makes established prayer function as the analogical fixed root.
Fruit as generated benefit supplies the non-botanical yield of the prayer-centered arrangement.

structural_cues: 14:24-25 moves from fixed root and elevated branch to recurring yield.
14:27 repeats stabilization immediately after the tree comparison.
14:37 juxtaposes no crop, established prayer, fruit, and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit word-tree and the focus's crop/prayer/fruit sequence; I supply the cross-domain mapping from rooted word to settled worshiping lineage. The live alternative is that the tree comparison remains about speech and only loosely echoes the focus.

changed_reading.before: The family needs fruit because nothing can be planted locally.
changed_reading.after: Precisely where agricultural planting fails, a prayer-centered lineage can be planted as a stable word-tree whose social and ethical effects bear recurring fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nearby negative sequence has leaders lodge their people in an abode of ruin with a terrible final settlement. The focus's causative settlement of descendants beside a protected house becomes the counter-placement: locating a people is an act of intergenerational moral governance.

activation_trace.role: Causing people to lodge in a place supplies the negative parallel to Abraham's act of settlement.
Ruin and corruption supply the outcome of the rival emplacement.
Fixity and final settlement supply the grim terminus of the rival dwelling.
Deliberate habitation supplies Abraham's contrasting placement of descendants.
A house as shelter supplies the positive dwelling around which the descendants are placed.
Protected sacred territory supplies the moral-spatial opposite of the abode of ruin.

structural_cues: 14:28 causatively places a قوم in a ruinous دار; 14:29 names its قرار.
14:37 causatively settles offspring beside a protected بيت and gives their placement a prayer purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two causative placements and sharply different dwellings; I infer a deliberate contrast in intergenerational leadership. A live alternative is that the parallel is lexical but subordinate to the broader blessing-versus-ingratitude contrast.

changed_reading.before: Abraham's act is an exceptional family relocation.
changed_reading.after: Abraham performs counter-governance: he places descendants in a protected ritual ecology instead of lodging a people in a trajectory of ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command immediately before the provisioning panorama joins established prayer to spending from received provision, secretly and openly. The focus's prayer, attracted hearts, and provision can therefore form a reciprocal community circuit rather than one-way consumption.

activation_trace.role: The outward passage of wealth as expenditure supplies redistribution from received provision.
Hidden action supplies the private channel of that redistribution.
Manifest action supplies the public channel of the same circulation.
Established upright practice links the focus settlement to the context's prayer-and-spending sequence.
Apportioned provision supplies what can enter and then circulate through the community.
Willing attachment supplies the social bond through which circulation can be sustained.

structural_cues: 14:31 sequences establishing prayer, spending from provision, and private/public modes.
14:37 sequences establishing prayer, attracted hearts, provision, and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two overlapping prayer-and-provision sequences; I infer that attracted hearts can mediate willing redistribution. The concrete channel could instead be trade, pilgrimage gifts, or another form of movement not specified by the packet.

changed_reading.before: Visitors arrive and the family receives food from them.
changed_reading.after: Prayer, attachment, provision, expenditure, and gratitude can compose a reciprocal social economy around the otherwise unproductive site.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water is delivered downward, fruit is brought out, ships and rivers are subjected to service, and gifts answer requests. The barren valley is therefore not outside provision but a local receiving channel within a larger directed system; moving people and transport can carry globally produced fruit to the fixed sanctuary node.

activation_trace.role: Delivery by bringing something down supplies the first directed transfer in the provisioning chain.
Bringing something out from concealment supplies fruit's emergence from the water-fed earth.
Subjection and direction toward a purpose supply the transport and river infrastructure of the chain.
Flowing and coursing supply actual conveyance through the system.
Giving and delivery supply the fulfillment side of human requests.
Asking and seeking supply the petition that the focus itself performs.
Beneficent good condition supplies the larger category under which the delivered goods are counted.
The valley's channel-form supplies a local receiver inside the larger circulation system.
Ripened fruit supplies the same commodity explicitly produced in the preceding provisioning panorama.
Apportioned giving names the requested local receipt of the global provision.

structural_cues: 14:32 explicitly makes fruit into provision and couples it to ships, flowing water, and rivers.
14:33 extends the service system through recurring cosmic cycles.
14:34 moves from what was asked to uncountable blessing immediately before Abraham's petitions in 14:35-41.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a directed production-and-transport chain followed by a local fruit request; I infer the global-to-local delivery arrow through people and movement. A live alternative is direct extraordinary provision rather than ordinary transport or exchange.

changed_reading.before: Fruit reaching a crop-less valley is an isolated exception to its ecology.
changed_reading.after: The crop-less valley is a receiving node in a divinely directed ecology of rain, emergence, transport, flowing channels, gifts, and human movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding prayer moves from a securely inhabited town and protected children, through gifted sons and accepted prayer, to parents, believers, and the day of account. The focus settlement is thus one relay in a multi-generation architecture for maintaining prayer and accountable belonging.

activation_trace.role: Remaining attached to an inhabited town supplies the civic scale around the focus household.
Security and settled confidence supply the protected condition sought for that civic setting.
A gift freely bestowed supplies the prior status of the sons whose descendants are being placed.
Reception with approval supplies the requested acceptance of the prayer relay.
Parentage through birth extends the lineage backward as the focus extends it forward.
Reckoning and account supply the terminal horizon of intergenerational responsibility.
Scattering seed or grain supplies an image of descendants distributed forward from one ancestor.
Guardianship and sustained care make maintaining prayer an inherited responsibility.

structural_cues: 14:35 begins the prayer with town, security, and children.
14:39 identifies sons as gifts and prayer as heard.
14:40 repeats making, prayer-establishment, and descendants directly after the focus.
14:41 expands the petition to parents and believers at the reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a continuous first-person prayer with repeated lineage and prayer language; I infer that the settlement is a transmission device across generations. The petitions can also be read as adjacent but independently scoped requests.

changed_reading.before: The prayer secures the immediate survival and worship of one displaced branch of the family.
changed_reading.after: The settlement is a relay station in an intergenerational chain: gift becomes descendant, descendant maintains prayer, accepted prayer embraces ancestors and believers, and the chain faces account.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later scene contains rapid approach, a gaze that does not return, and hearts described as air or void. Its reuse of heart and h-w-y reverses the focus: movement alone is insufficient; the desired approach is inwardly heated and willingly relational, unlike compelled rushing with evacuated interiors.

activation_trace.role: Rapid forward approach supplies bodily movement without implying willing attachment.
Failure of return supplies a gaze locked away from normal reciprocal movement.
A heart weakened toward heartlessness supplies the depleted interior of the reversal.
Air and inner vacancy supply the explicit emptiness predicated of those hearts.
The inwardly heated heart supplies the positive interior opposed to vacancy.
Desiring inclination supplies voluntary relational movement rather than compelled speed.

structural_cues: 14:37 joins أفئدة with the verb تهوي toward a human destination.
14:43 joins أفئدتهم with هواء inside a scene of rushing bodies and non-returning sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated heart and h-w-y forms in opposite motion scenes; I infer a qualitative reversal between inhabited desire and evacuated haste. A live alternative is ordinary polysemy: تهوي and هواء need not form an intended contrast.

changed_reading.before: Successful attraction is measured by people physically arriving.
changed_reading.after: The prayer seeks filled, willing hearts that move relationally; the surah later shows that rapid arrival can coexist with inward vacancy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus explicitly denies cultivation, yet it remains anchored in its valley, fruit, and inbound-flow language when read beside the flowing garden. Render only as an analogical present preview of garden-like provision, not as an identification of the sanctuary with the eschatological garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ ... تَهْوِى إِلَيْهِمْ ... مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ

activation_trace.role: A garden screened by trees supplies the lush spatial pattern unexpectedly echoed by the barren focus site.
Continuous coursing supplies the garden's life-bearing flow.
A river cutting earth with running water supplies the garden's material channel.
A valley as a floodcourse supplies an empty channel capable of receiving redirected flows.
Cultivated growth supplies the expressly absent feature that makes the analogy surprising.
Ripened fruit supplies the garden-like yield requested without local cultivation.

changed_reading.before: The barren valley merely receives imported food.
changed_reading.after: The prayer experimentally makes an uncultivated channel perform a garden-pattern through converging life, flowing provision, and fruit without claiming that it is the promised garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus does not discuss cosmic replacement, but it remains anchored in settlement, house, and upright practice when the later earth itself changes. Render as a caution against making topographic permanence the focus's final claim, not as a denial of the house's protected status.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَسْكَنتُ ... عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ ... لِيُقِيمُوا ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ

activation_trace.role: Transformation of a thing's form supplies the later instability of the entire earthly setting.
Emergence into exposure supplies the movement from local shelter to universal standing.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the enduring center after geographic forms change.
Cessation and stability supply the local permanence that the later scene relativizes.
Shelter and dwelling supply the focus's concrete spatial anchor.
Upright ordered practice supplies what can outlast the provisional geography.

changed_reading.before: The protected house is the prayer's final stable geography.
changed_reading.after: The house is a real but provisional earthly anchor whose prayer-order trains a community for the enduring divine center beyond transformed geography.

strongest_changes: The barren settlement became a fixed sanctuary node inside a larger circulation system of rain, fruit, transport, people, and gifts.
Heart-inclination became a contested, non-coercive orientation rather than generic affection.
The good-tree sequence turned no-crop, established prayer, fruit, and gratitude into a ritual cultivation model.
The ruinous-dwelling contrast turned family placement into intergenerational moral governance.
The gratitude promise changed fruit-to-thanks from a line into a potentially regenerative loop.
summary.what_was_special: The focus binds apparent opposites unusually tightly: fixed habitation with rapid inbound movement, no cultivation with fruit, protected enclosure with wide human circulation, and inward heat with falling desire. The later reversal from hearts that تهوي to hearts that are هواء made the quality of movement, not mere arrival, especially diagnostic.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus use of ه و ي may foreground affection, downward pull, or rapid travel; the packet keeps all three live.
The increase following gratitude may return as material provision, broader flourishing, or deferred reward.
The tree and garden models depend on reader-supplied cross-domain mapping even though their roots, stability, flow, and yield are packet-local.
The packet supports circulation through people but does not specify whether its ordinary vehicle is trade, pilgrimage, gifts, spending, or another institution.
The later transformed-earth scene may qualify geographic permanence without directly commenting on the protected house.
